name: Benjamin F. Lamb
role: Rancher down the river from Medora; Billings County probate judge, 1886
bio: A B. F. Lamb of Boston visited the Bad Lands to hunt in October 1884, and by spring 1885 Lamb was readying a ranch for cattle, adopting a connected BL brand, and in July he bought 68 head of M bar cattle. That summer he finished a ranch building four miles down the river, and in September 1885 he was elected a member of the Little Missouri River Stockgrowers Association. In spring 1886 he bought J. A. VanEeghen's horses at about $75 a head and kept improving his ranch. He signed a call for a caucus in September 1886, was nominated unanimously for probate judge that October and was elected in November.
